headline: Fire Ravaged the Glasgow School of Art. It May Cost Too Much to Restore It.
context: Designed by Charles Rennie Mackintosh, the Glasgow School of Art is one of Britain’s most famous buildings. The school says it can’t undertake a planned “faithful restoration” alone.

sources.name: The New York Times
